verdict.rationale: Docs claim AI agents can surface deep intelligence, actionable insights, risk/progress gap detection, and automated reports/summaries directly in monday (docs-20, docs-21, docs-22, docs-23, docs-32), which matches the story of in-product AI-generated insights. However, evidence is entirely vendor marketing copy with no independent/hands-on validation of insight quality or accuracy, and community feedback focuses on performance/UX issues rather than AI insight capability. Missing for 10: independent verification of insight quality, concrete examples/screenshots of generated insights, and hands-on user reports confirming the feature works as described.
